repos_data.description: A curated list of software, services, and resources to create and distribute music

AI-powered FL Studio control via the Model Context Protocol. Beyond piano-roll notes — full in-DAW mixing (Mix Doctor, gain staging, EQ/comp/reverb, reference matching), routing, and composition through Claude and other MCP clients. 67 tools. Windows & macOS.
AI-powered music production and post-production in REAPER via MCP — 181 tools for composition, mixing, mastering, batch editing, audio QC, and ReaScript automation.
Model Context Protocol server that enables AI assistants to control REAPER for mixing, mastering, MIDI composition and music production.
Local MCP server for Ableton Live: session inspection, MIDI editing, device control, audio analysis and groove tools via a Python Remote Script.
